scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:desktop
scripts.verify:quick: npm run validate:compose && npm run test:core && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend:ci && npm run test:desktop
scripts.verify:local: npm run validate:compose && cd packages/backend && npm run lint && NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL= JWT_SECRET=test-secret-for-ci-only-at-least-32-chars npm test && cd ../frontend && npm run lint && npm run gradendex:extra && cd ../.. && git diff --exit-code -- packages/frontend/src/i18n/gradendex.*.json && cd packages/frontend && CI=true npm test -- --watchAll=false --runInBand && REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:5000 CI=false npm run build && cd ../.. && npm run test:core && npm run test:desktop
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd packages/frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:frontend && cd packages/desktop && npm run build
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:frontend && cd packages/desktop && npm run dist:win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:frontend && cd packages/desktop && npm run dist:mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:frontend && cd packages/desktop && npm run dist:linux
scripts.mobile:setup: cd packages/frontend && npx cap add android && npx cap add ios
scripts.mobile:sync: cd packages/frontend && npm run build && npx cap sync
